lead_records_per_line: forge-gpu-run exit, the inner timeout exit (124 = timeout, never a pass), the run log's sha256 (L45)
exit_semantics: gate 3 = refused before the lease (module sha or write-once path); forge-gpu-run 75/76 = no window or lease (nothing ran); 124 = timeout; step 0 = completed, verdict in its results.json and last stdout line; a G4 step exits 0 at once when its series is complete
rlimit_as: none set (L114); the lead runs each line in a scope with MemoryMax=12G, OOMPolicy=continue
post_device_followups_cpu: python3 -B -P scripts/bwdf1_gpu_post.py line <line>   (each G2/G3/copy line: memcheck summary + verdict -> artifacts/bwdf1/gpu/<line>.post.json)

python3 -B -P scripts/bwdf1_gpu_post.py g4             (G4 GPU per-ID, B vs E)
